rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term when the context clearly means a driving licence rather than a vehicle licence plate.

example.english: I always carry my driver's license when I go out driving.
example.traditional: 我出街揸車一定會帶住車牌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 zaa1 ce1 jat1 ding6 wui5 daai3 zyu6 ce1 paai4

rows.note: Use this formal, official term on documents, in regulations, or when you want to be completely unambiguous.

example.english: When applying to renew your driver's license, please bring the original identity card.
example.traditional: 申請續領駕駛執照嗰陣，請帶埋身份證正本。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 zuk6 ling5 gaa3 sai2 zap1 ziu3 go2 zan6 ceng2 daai3 maai4 san1 fan2 zing3 zing3 bun2

rows.note: Use this shorter direct term in more formal or Mandarin-influenced usage instead of the longer official term.

example.english: The car rental company requires me to fill in my driver's license number on the form.
example.traditional: 租車公司要求我喺表格上填寫駕照號碼。
example.jyutping: zou1 ce1 gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 hai2 biu2 gaak3 soeng6 tin4 se2 gaa3 ziu3 hou6 maa5
